subject: Reconciliation of post-term usage windfall and proposed upgrade timeline
messages:
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@novaprod.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Reconciliation of post-term usage windfall and proposed upgrade timeline

Hi Carlos —

Thanks again for the candid note on last quarter's spike. We ran a quick audit and found a ~27% usage overshoot across inference-hours between May 8–June 22 that fell outside the committed capacity period. I want to propose two straightforward paths so we can close this out quickly and set Novaprod up for the expected growth:

1) One-time windfall reconciliation charge (net of a 15% customer loyalty concession) + immediate capacity top-up to the 2x tier, effective Aug 1.
2) Alternatively, amortize the one-time charge across a 6-month supplement and roll into an upgraded annual commit with predictable pricing.

I attached a CSV with the per-day usage slices and a short amortization schedule I sketched. Neither option affects historical SLAs. If you prefer, we can also convert the reconciliation to a credit against future overage consumption instead of a cash invoice.

Can you confirm which path you want to take? If option 2, I'll loop in Billing and Legal and draft the addendum; option 1 we can invoice in July and apply the top-up the same day.

Thanks — available for a quick call this afternoon if helpful.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138
From: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@novaprod.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Billing <billing@novaprod.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@novaprod.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reconciliation of post-term usage windfall and proposed upgrade timeline

Jasmine —

Appreciate the quick triage and the attached breakdown. Two clarifying Qs before we choose:

• Can you send the daily run-rate split by environment (prod vs staging)? Our ops team believes some of that spike came from a misrouted staging traffic job.
• If we amortize, what would the monthly impact be on our committed payments and can we see the amort schedule as a pdf?

Our preference is to avoid a single large invoice if possible; Priya in Finance prefers amortization or crediting against the next two invoices. We also want to ensure any top-up capacity is provisioned without a rekey on our side (need VPC continuity).

Carlos
VP Product, Novaprod
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@novaprod.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-19T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reconciliation of post-term usage windfall and proposed upgrade timeline

Hi Carlos — attaching the environment-split you requested (prod_vs_staging_breakdown.csv). Short summary: ~78% of the excess is prod-facing inference; ~22% traces to a scheduled test harness that was mistakenly left active for 6 days in early June. We've redacted internal request IDs in the CSV for privacy.

On amortization: if you pick the 6-month plan, the gross reconciliation amount after the 15% concession is $42,300. Amortized across six months that maps to ~$7,050/month. I also exported a clean PDF of the proposed amortization schedule (proposed_amort_schedule.pdf) which shows an option to apply 50% of each monthly amort to invoices vs applying a monthly credit.

We can provision the 2x capacity top-up as a non-disruptive overlay in your existing VPC; engineering confirmed no rekey or additional network steps needed. We can schedule the overlay for Aug 1 at 02:00 PT to minimize traffic impact.

If Finance wants, I can convert the amortization into a billing credit ledger entry instead of an invoice — that's what Priya mentioned as a preference.

— Ben
Ben Carter | Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
Attachment: prod_vs_staging_breakdown.csv (CSV, 24 KB)
Attachment: proposed_amort_schedule.pdf (PDF, 18 KB)
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@novaprod.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Billing <billing@novaprod.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@novaprod.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reconciliation of post-term usage windfall and proposed upgrade timeline

Ben/Jasmine —

Thanks for the breakdown and the amort schedule. Novaprod will proceed with the 6-month amortization and would like the monthly amort to be applied as a ledger credit that offsets the invoice line item for committed capacity (not as a separate invoice). Please confirm:

1) That Redwood can post the credit entry to our account on the first business day of each month, starting Aug 1, 2026.
2) That the 2x capacity overlay will be scheduled for Aug 1 at 02:00 PT and not require any network changes on our side.

We also need a short addendum to the MSA clarifying the amortization and capacity change; legal will accept a one-page addendum. Can you send a draft by COB tomorrow?

Best,
— Priya Rao
Director of Finance, Novaprod
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@novaprod.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Finance Billing <billing@novaprod.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reconciliation of post-term usage windfall and proposed upgrade timeline

Priya/Carlos —

Perfect — thank you. Confirming next steps:

• Redwood will post a ledger credit equal to the reconciled net amount divided across six months; first credit posted on 2026-08-03 (first business day after Aug 1).
• Engineering will schedule the 2x capacity overlay for 2026-08-01 02:00 PT (no rekey/network changes).
• I'll draft a one-page MSA addendum that: records the post-term reconciliation amount, the 6-month amort approach (credits applied to committed capacity invoices), and the capacity top-up effective Aug 1. Draft will be in your inbox by COB 2026-07-21; Ben will loop in Billing for the ledger entry.

Looping in Lauren from Customer Success to coordinate the onboarding and any runbook updates for the overlay.

— Jasmine
Jasmine Liu | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0138
